name: Kestrel
description: Workspace security settings for a B2B customer support platform. This context covers the SSO enforcement feature, not the whole product.
business_goals: Help enterprise customers pass security review with enforceable SSO
Reduce password-related support load when employees change teams
Make a high-risk security action safe to operate and recover from

users.name: Workspace Owner
users.description: Accountable for billing, workspace deletion and security enforcement.
needs: Understand what enforcement changes before turning it on
Keep a recovery path if the identity provider is unavailable
See who configured the connection and when it was last changed

users.name: Workspace Admin
users.description: Runs workspace setup and member management but does not control billing or enforcement.
needs: Connect and verify the identity provider without waiting for an Owner
Understand why the enforcement control is unavailable
Know when a change requires an Owner

users.name: Support Agent
users.description: Works customer conversations in shared inboxes.
needs: Sign in reliably through the company identity provider
Understand why a password no longer works after enforcement
Reach the right person when access fails

constraints.brand_guidelines: Calm, explicit settings UI; no marketing treatment inside security settings
technical_constraints: No SCIM, multi-IdP or automatic provisioning in scope
No in-app purchase flow; plan changes go through the account team
The current security route is Owner-only and must change so Admins can configure the connection

design_preferences.style: Existing Kestrel settings patterns; low density and explicit consequence copy
